title: Complementary critical probability
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and let $p_c$ denote its critical probability. The complementary critical probability is $1-p_c$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the characterization of the critical probability.
